title.narrative: Pacific Recovery Economic Support (PRES) Plus (2024-25 to 2030-2031)

description.narrative:
PRES Plus is an up to AUD55 million investment over two phases. Annually there is $3m in core funding and up to $7m in commissions. PRES+ provides flexible, high-quality technical expertise to support economic analysis, program implementation and policy development in the Pacific. It will provide access to skilled specialists to foster strategic economic dialogue and support delivery of the Pacific Direct Financing Fund (PDFF).
PRES+ has two End of Program Outcomes:
EOPO 1: Responsive, flexible and high quality economic advice strengthens development effectiveness in targeted programs in the Pacific. EOPO 2: PRES+ contributes to economic and public financial management reforms in Pacific island countries through technical advice and strengthening the delivery of budget support.
PRES+ will support financing activities, private sector development, budget support, policy reform, economic analysis, aviation, trade, gender and climate change activities and may include non-ODA.
